## Football effect

Johnson played all 70 offensive snaps at right tackle; the one sack of the game, Kerrigan's on third-and-4 at 13:07 of the fourth quarter, is charged to his slot by the receipt, which records the slot and not the cause (Yarno's review item), and the injury was logged at the end of that possession. Jacksonville ran for 171 on 37 carries behind the five. On the projection he misses the Monday review on the field and the Wednesday practice of the Indianapolis week; his availability follows the medical staff's communication, not the projection. Cornelius Lucas is the chart's first reserve tackle. No role change follows and no football finding attaches to the instruction.
